name: A capability architecture, read top to bottom
useWhen: An offer has layers — goals, strategies, capabilities, enablers — and the point is both that they stack in that order and that one layer is where all the substance lives.

focal.note: Measured on the hero rail's label, but the real focal device is AREA — the dominant band takes about half the stack. Proportion is doing what size usually does.

replacesNote: Nothing in the kit draws a layered architecture. process-timeline-v6 is a phase board read left to right; this reads top to bottom and the order is the argument.

deviations.source: line icons from outside the §8 suite
deviations.why: Icons are a per-deck choice and the groups read without them.
